(ii) The root gates that read the sequence literally (`scripts/check-pnpm-acquisition.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` self-test, and any other the gate run names) are taught the composite, with new self-test cases; behaviour otherwise unchanged. Overlap with #25452 (assignee `os-elon-musk`): its directive (c) also makes the pnpm store restore-only on PRs and the queue; here the composite owns the store step, so that half lands with this card and #25452 keeps the Next.js cache and the Turbo seeds (comment on #25452)
